purpose: Measure changes in candidate overlap geometry caused by each backend pose revision with local maps frozen
correspondences: E2a optical flow candidates, not independently validated pixel ground truth
local_geometry: E3 initial self pointmaps and last per-keyframe fusion snapshots, matched to E4 backend snapshots before use
pose_comparison: for each backend solve after KF36 exists, apply its pre and post pose to the same frozen map points; signed normal is from pre-solve source points; same support throughout
limitations: frozen geometry at earlier historical poses is a controlled replay, not necessarily the historical map; comparisons are internal consistency, no GT or metric scale; pose updates can be coupled with earlier tracking and fusion
